Both projections enter one scene with inherited configuration and distinct runtime IDs; real Godot player moves 45px while NPC stays still. Source OC, projections, images and definitions remain byte-identical.
Opening and saving a hand-authored partial inheritance scene preserves an explicit speed override, imageResourceId:null, missing inherited fields, BOM/CRLF, tabs and schemaVersion:1e0 exactly.

Three-language existing-scene form edits canvas, position, partial overrides and actor membership without changing scene UUID, OC, projections or images. Conflict retains the draft; save modifies only scene source and metadata and invalidates the previous plan.
Real Godot rebuild uses only the two current actors, the new scene image and the per-scene speed override: player moves 80px while the added projection is held still by the controls override.
Reload discovers the same edited scene UUID and retains partial overrides and all three projections; authoring bytes remain unchanged.
